snippets.note: Shared rendering kernel: thread-private counters, deterministic per-sample RNG (the line with Rng rng{…}).
BVH traversal with the fixed-size stack (the heap-allocation fix).
OpenMP backend: one parallel loop over tiles.
Static MPI: contiguous equal-count tile range per rank.
Dynamic coordinator: dispatch, MPI_Recv(MPI_ANY_SOURCE), throughput update, next dispatch.
Worker loop: receive assignment, render, send tiles back, stop on count 0.
Adaptive batch size: target ~50 ms from measured throughput, clamp 1..8, fairness taper.
